Original's asymmetry and paper warmth; no border or letterboxing.
Constraints: Render only the three specified text lines exactly once. No additional slogans, fake labels, watermark, logos or repeated text. No Wukang building, no random literal skyline. This is an artistic impression, never a geographic floor plan. Native 2:1 image, not a 16:9 scene cut down; build whole composition for 2:1.
